description: We are a team of university students interesting in working with new technologies and using data-driven approaches to solve problems und push technological boundaries.
summary: TrendDetective is an interactive Earth-system trend and extreme-event analysis platform that lets anyone investigate how climate variables evolve at any point or predefined region on a 3D globe.
details: TrendDetective addresses the challenge of fragmented, hard-to-query climate datasets by letting users select any geographic region on the globe, define a custom date range and aggregation interval (days, months, or years), filter environmental topics, and apply statistical tools such as Linear Regression and Welch's t-Test with a single click. The platform automatically fetches station observations, aggregates time series, computes trend slopes and statistical significance, and visualizes the results directly on the map and in interactive charts.
